llm_response.reason: The website dafxi.com exhibits numerous scam characteristics: it offers extremely high leverage (up to 1:20,000) and instant deposits/withdrawals, making unrealistic financial promises. Claims of being a 'regulated broker' are not backed up by verifiable evidence or transparent company details—the listed registrant data is vague, anonymized, and contains a personal Gmail address, while name servers are set to 'suspended-domain.com.' The domain was registered only recently in March 2025, a common trait of scam sites. The customer support contact is just a generic email with no phone or physical address. Together, these factors closely match the common warning signs for investment scams.
